texts:
According to the Pokémon anime series, Pikachu is approximately 7 years old when it first meets Ash Ketchum. Since the series premiered in 1997, and assuming the series timeline moves at roughly the same pace as the real world, Pikachu would be around 25 years old by now.

However, in the Pokémon universe, Pikachu ages at a much slower rate compared to real-life animals. A Pokémon researcher, Dr. Oak, once mentioned in an episode that Pikachu can live for up to 50 years in the wild, and its growth rate is much slower than that of real-life animals.

Considering Pikachu's slow growth rate and assuming it's still actively battling, I'd estimate that Pikachu is roughly around 15-20 years old in "Pokémon years".

Ash's Pikachu is approximately 6 years old. Pikachu was a wild Pokémon that Ash Ketchum, the main character of the Pokémon series, caught at the start of his Pokémon journey. Since Ash was 10 years old when he caught Pikachu, and he is currently 16 years old in the anime series, it can be inferred that Pikachu is around 6 years old.

Ash's Pikachu is roughly 30 years old. Pikachu was introduced in the Pokémon anime in 1997, and since Pokémon age in real-time just like the characters, Pikachu has aged alongside Ash. In the show's lore, Pikachu was already a few years old when it first started traveling with Ash, adding those years to its total age today.

The exact age of Ash's Pikachu has never been officially stated in the Pokémon anime. Pikachu was already a fully grown Pokémon when Ash received him from Professor Oak at the beginning of his journey. Since Ash started his journey when he was 10 years old, and given that the anime has been running since 1997, one might assume Pikachu would be quite old. However, Pokémon in the anime don't seem to age in the same way as real animals, and Ash himself has remained perpetually young throughout the series. Therefore, Pikachu's actual age remains unclear and is one of those details that the series deliberately leaves ambiguous.
